T: Big plans. Small cousins. Bad luck.
D: Two cousins working in a Village restaurant plan a safe job that goes sideways.
P: Pour the wine when Paulie gets caught skimming and loses them both their jobs.
S: prosciutto, melon and bocconcini, what Charlie plates up every night
Prosciutto draped over ripe rockmelon wedges, bocconcini dressed with basil oil (basil blitzed with oil and salt) and cracked pepper.
Steam clams open, remove top shells, top with breadcrumbs, garlic, oregano, parmesan and olive oil, grill until golden.
Paulie's racetrack pepper and egg rolls
for a day at the track with Paulie's racehorse

Soft rolls stuffed with eggs scrambled through sweet fried capsicum and onion, pecorino and chilli, wrapped in paper. Thinly slice 2 red capsicums and 1 onion and fry in 3 tbsp olive oil over medium heat for 15 minutes until soft and sweet. Whisk 8 eggs with 30g grated pecorino, salt and pepper. Pour over the capsicum, then stir gently over low heat for 2 to 3 minutes until just set. Split 4 soft long rolls, fill with the eggs, add chilli flakes and cut each in half.
M: Charlie's restaurant, before the big plan
Clams steamed open in garlic, chilli and white wine, linguine finished in the juices, parsley.
the dish Charlie plates while dreaming of his own place
Veal floured and seared, set aside. Mushrooms browned in the pan, marsala and stock reduced by half, cold butter whisked in, veal back to warm through.
W: whisked at the table, the way Charlie dreams of running his own place
Whisk 4 yolks, 60g sugar and 80ml marsala over simmering water for 6 to 8 minutes until thick and tripled. Serve warm over berries.
K: poured by Charlie, the maître d' who wants his own place

Bitter red aperitivo and sweet vermouth over ice, topped with cold soda and a fat slice of orange. Fill 4 tumblers with ice. Pour 40ml bitter red aperitivo and 40ml sweet vermouth into each glass and stir for 10 seconds. Top each with 80ml chilled soda water and stir once more. Cut 1 orange into thick half-moons and tuck one into each glass. Serve before the mains, the way Charlie would.

s.note: Clams under golden garlic, oregano and parmesan crumbs.
s.how: Steam 1kg clams with a splash of water in a covered pan until they open, about 4 minutes, and discard any closed ones. Remove the top shells. Mix 60g breadcrumbs, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, 30g grated parmesan and 3 tbsp olive oil. Top each clam and grill for 3 minutes until golden.

s.note: Prosciutto on rockmelon, with bocconcini dressed in bright basil oil.
s.how: Cut 1 rockmelon into 12 skinless wedges and drape with 120g prosciutto. Blitz a bunch of basil with 80ml olive oil and a pinch of salt. Drain 220g bocconcini, dress with the basil oil and cracked pepper and serve beside the melon.

m.note: Seared veal escalopes in a glossy mushroom and marsala sauce.
m.how: Dust 600g veal escalopes in seasoned flour and sear in butter and oil for 1 minute a side, then set aside. Brown 250g sliced button mushrooms in the same pan, add 150ml marsala and 150ml beef stock and reduce by half. Whisk in 40g cold butter, return the veal and warm through for a minute. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Warm whisked marsala custard spooned over fresh strawberries.
w.how: Whisk 4 egg yolks, 60g caster sugar and 80ml marsala in a heatproof bowl over simmering water for 6 to 8 minutes until thick, pale and tripled in volume. Spoon warm over 250g halved strawberries in four glasses and serve straight away.

d.note: Bitter red aperitivo and sweet vermouth over ice, topped with cold soda and a fat slice of orange.
d.how: Fill 4 tumblers with ice. Pour 40ml bitter red aperitivo and 40ml sweet vermouth into each glass and stir for 10 seconds. Top each with 80ml chilled soda water and stir once more. Cut 1 orange into thick half-moons and tuck one into each glass. Serve before the mains, the way Charlie would.
